# Google Calendar Skill for Muse

💳 Paid service required — needs a Google Workspace account (personal Gmail accounts are not supported).
Curated by Skill Harbor — a free, open-source skill (Apache-2.0) by @sanjay3290, listed here with credit to its creator. A lightweight Google Calendar integration through provided Python scripts, with self-contained OAuth (no MCP server required): list calendars, list, view, create, update, and delete events with attendees, locations, and descriptions, find free slots across participants, and RSVP to invitations (accepted/declined/tentative). Tokens live in the system keychain (macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Locker, Linux Secret Service) with automatic refresh. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: a Google Workspace account is required — personal Gmail accounts are excluded — plus Python 3 with pip packages and a one-time browser OAuth flow. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
